schema.title: alias

description:
The **list** alias is a simple shortcut that runs `ls -la`. It operates silently, so the command output is shown without a preceding echo, and it does not prompt you for confirmation before executing.

The **deploy** alias runs the script `./deploy.sh`. Before it starts, you will be asked to confirm with the prompt “Proceed with deployment?”. It only runs when the condition `/usr/bin/which docker` succeeds, and if anything goes wrong it will automatically back out after **10 seconds**. A built‑in unit test checks that the Git working tree is clean (`[ $(git status --porcelain) = '' ]`). Unlike the list alias, the deploy command is displayed before execution.
